name: Gen II Sensr Portal

web.notes: Investor portal and data room; login URL and MFA not published in the sources reviewed.

api.notes: No LP API described. Sensr DataBridge is a separate no-code data feed from Gen II to client (GP) systems.

notes: Gen II's proprietary investor portal and data room, formerly Update Capital, renamed Sensr Portal in May 2024 (high confidence). February 2026 release adds an AI layer: natural-language search and summaries of capital call and distribution notices and quarterly and annual reports, Q&A on performance and capital balances, investor-specific alerts, ring-fenced to each investor's data, connected to Gen II's general ledger. Funded digital subscription platform links to it.
